# Formal results (generated by `make formal B=<block>`; do not edit sections by hand)

Environment assumptions and where they are discharged (assume-guarantee):
- seq: `gnt` = `req` ∧ own slot of a constant map (jspe_arb, proven); the engine owns ≥ 1 slot (ARCH 2.2).
- seq: EXEC only to a stopped engine without a pending injection; RUN/STEP never while one is pending; at most one pulse kind per clock (HOSTIF 9, D077, D107) — discharged by link a_exec, a_rsx, a_one (k-induction with the host bit stream free, so they hold for any host behaviour: no host rule needed).
- link: host bit stream free; engine side only as proven without the link env (seq a_run_up, a_xm_up) and arb a_hgnt (`h_gnt` ⇒ `h_req`); tasks cover and bmc cut the receiver to bytes at most every other clock and free the transmitter's busy flag (proofs keep the real receiver and transmitter). Reply escapes are uninterrupted only under the HOSTIF 3 host rule (one reply at a time): by D085 a new reply drops an owed reply code, which a_esc exempts; notice, stream and event escapes have no exception.
- pins: none, every input free (reset in step 0 only).
- epins: none, every input free (reset in step 0 only). Top level: only jspe_link drives `pad_we`/`pad_idx`/`pad_wdata` (no engine path to a PAD register).
- fifo: none except flush (= engine reset, top `eng_rst`) in step 0; W = 8 and 9 (results listed per task).
- top: arbitrary initial state (no initial value assumed for any design flop, so a reset value reached is X-free); prove/cover cut every block but the pins and the top glue to free outputs, so a_rst and a_safe hold for any link, engine, FIFO and memory behaviour (the host's "PAD write with en = 1" is an enabling `pad_we`, tied to the WRREG bytes by link a_reg); idle: whole chip minus the memory, reset 3 clk, then H_RX high, bmc 40. After the host enables a pad or requests data, outputs carry program/link data, undefined only if the program or host reads undefined registers or memory (ARCH 9.1, by design).
- timer: none, every input free (instruction, fire, operand, register writes, pin edges; reset in step 0 only); a_lat checks the ARCH 7 timing formula for pre = 0 with a symbolic start value.
- shift: none, every input free (reset in step 0 only); an S register or ld write-back in the clock of a shift (not possible in the engine) follows the RTL priority (D118).
- sig: none, every input free incl. any bits on the engine request buses (the engines send one-hot requests from sset/sclr; any pattern is checked).
- lfsr: none, every input free incl. configuration indices 5-7; LFSR and POLY are not compared in a clock after a reset clock (ARCH 9.1: not reset, undefined until written).

Helper invariants (`h_*`) are proven like the properties; they strengthen the induction.

Mutants (generated by `make mutate B=<block>` from formal/mutants/<block>.yaml; caught = a prove task fails with a counterexample; equivalent survivors carry their reason in that file):

- epins: 26 tried, 26 caught (2026-11-19)
- fifo: 14 tried, 14 caught (2026-11-19)
- lfsr: 11 tried, 11 caught (2026-11-19)

- shift: 21 tried, 21 caught (2026-11-19)
